title: ExpectedBand
description: Expected units for one variant on one day with NO price change, plus an honest interval. Written by Lane C into `expected_bands`, consumed by Lane B's evaluator and drawn as the uncertainty band in Lane A's rollout chart. The band's calibration is a SAFETY property: it decides auto-rollback (R29).

low.description: Lower edge of the interval. Must be <= expected_units. For low-volume SKUs this is floored (a Poisson-plausible zero is not a breach).

interval.description: Nominal coverage of [low, high], e.g. 0.8 for an 80% interval.

band_kind.description: baseline = business-as-usual forecast (C3). counterfactual = conditioned on pre-change data for a specific rollout (C5); requires rollout_id.

breach_probability.description: C5: P(true effect is worse than the guardrail threshold). When present and the model has beaten thresholds on the harness, the evaluator prefers this over raw threshold crossing (R29).

is_floored.description: true when the low edge was widened by the low-volume floor rather than coming from the residual quantiles.
